stem:
Read these lines from the poem.

I felt beaten splashing out to see
How little garden was left to me.

The poet uses these lines to show that the speaker feels —

options.label: B
options.text: confused by the effect the rain had on the garden

options.label: C
options.text: burdened by the amount of work required to manage a garden

options.label: D
options.text: concerned that the storm has not ended
